channels.name: Gear House
channels.tagline: Short motoring documentaries and road stories.
channels.description: Gear House makes short-form documentaries about cars and the people who drive them — buying them badly, fixing them worse, and driving them a very long way.

channels.name: Open Frame
channels.tagline: Open-licence films and the craft behind them.
channels.description: Open Frame collects openly licensed films — the Blender Foundation's open movies among them — and the making-of stories around independent animation and effects work.

channels.name: First Light
channels.tagline: Where the internet started filming itself.
channels.description: A small archive channel about the early web — the first uploads, the first formats, and the people who did not know they were making history.
